blockers_for_historical_validation: Bathymetry is 'TERRAIN_ONLY_CHANNEL_APPROXIMATION' (requires verified sub-surface riverbed soundings/cross-sections).
Upstream forcing is 'COMPUTED_BREACH_OUTFLOW' (requires continuous hourly/sub-hourly SCADA gate telemetry).
Downstream boundary is 'APPROXIMATE_NORMAL_DEPTH' (requires field-calibrated stage-discharge rating curve).
Roughness is 'LITERATURE_DEFAULTS' (requires hydraulic calibration against observed flood high-water marks).
Vertical datum is 'EGM96_UNVERIFIED_GAUGE_OFFSET' (requires surveyed tie between gauge zero and EGM96 geoid).

equations.discharge_equation: Broad-crested trapezoidal weir Q = 1.704 * B * H^1.5 + 0.93 * Z * H^2.5
equations.routing_equation: Level-pool mass balance dV/dt = Inflow - Outflow
